ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels covering approximately 90-95% of the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the median notch and trailing edge borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous solid black expanse. Distinct high-contrast white focal spots and mottling are mapped around the median notch vertex and in discrete 5-10 pixel width strips along sections of the trailing edge topography.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth extending significantly into the fluke peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2 to 15 pixels; peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the right lobe (image right) trailing edge relative to the smoother leading edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the leading edges transitioning to a broad convex curve on the trailing lobes, terminating in sharp lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes and along the anterior leading edge of the left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected on the surface of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle encrustation on the fluke tips; minor irregular notch/tissue loss on the mid-section of the right lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized white pigmentation splash at the immediate vertex of the median notch.
